rng.method: Python secrets.SystemRandom backed by OS CSPRNG
rng.seed_rule: No seed invented or recorded because SystemRandom does not expose a deterministic seed receipt.

novelty_check.interpretation: No recent SPAWN_RECEIPT was discoverable through the available repository search surface; this is not a proof that no historical spawn receipt exists anywhere outside indexed results.

candidate_microdirections.title: Ubuntu foreign-code effect closure
candidate_microdirections.question: Can ClayCode enforce EffectiveEffects(child) subseteq Effects(parent) across Python, Bash, native code, WASM/WASI, FFI and subprocesses on the Ubuntu target without crippling normal build/test/admin utility?
candidate_microdirections.why_now: Directly targets current BASE Runtime/ABI/FFI, type/effect, general application suite and fuzz/conformance gaps.
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: A child obtains an undeclared protected effect or required ordinary utility is materially lost under the enforcement design.

candidate_microdirections.title: Translation-validation effect equivalence
candidate_microdirections.question: Can target syscall/resource effects be proven equivalent to Clay semantic effect contracts across native and WASM lowering?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: Equivalent Clay programs lower to observably different authority/effect envelopes without a receipt-visible difference.

candidate_microdirections.title: Recoverability monotonicity under real system work
candidate_microdirections.question: Can filesystem, DB deployment and migration effects preserve the declared recoverability order across crash/restart/rollback?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: An allowed model-originated operation reduces protected recoverability without an external irreversible authorization receipt.

candidate_microdirections.title: Nested capability non-amplification under injection
candidate_microdirections.question: Can prompt/tool/memory injection fail to expand authority through nested generated-code and tool calls?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: Injected information causes a child or broker path to gain an effect not present in the parent grant or external grant receipt.

candidate_microdirections.title: Safe-effect utility frontier
candidate_microdirections.question: Where is the Pareto knee between ordinary Ubuntu developer utility and reachable protected damage under progressively stricter effect mediation?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: No configuration materially reduces protected damage without unacceptable task failure or latency/resource cost.

microdirection_selection.method: Python secrets.SystemRandom.choice over the five eligible, non-duplicate candidates

probability_boundary: The stochastic selection affects research origin only and gives the selected hypothesis no evidential advantage.
